reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, and a sachet I can toss in my bag fixes that. Named lab and a batch report make me trust it more than a random TikTok Shop brand, and at $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I'll try one box.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I don't know if magnesium will actually help me. If I forget the sachets too, I've wasted the money.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was the full $29.99 for one box, I would pass.
